attribution.note: Marcus directly endorses the rejection in his own words.

semantics.note: The categorical rejection concerns the under-a-decade cure timeline identified in context. Clinical-development obstacles are reasons, not conditions.

contract.note: Reading this as rejection of the combined four-category cure forecast is ordinary and fair. Unspecified cure breadth and the two-day deadline adjustment do not affect the present result.

evidence.note: The FDA overview predates the cutoff and explains clinical validation requirements. It establishes neither an unavoidable development duration nor the outcome of the cure forecast.

reviews.rationale: The contextual deadline is in November 2036. The packet supplies no independently validated attainment of the complete cure threshold that would permit early resolution. Current clinical requirements cannot establish future failure.
